phases.title: The first descent
phases.label: Alpha & $DCG
phases.summary: Launch $DCG on Robinhood Chain through PonsFamily and open the alpha expedition. Put the game in players' hands, welcome agent-driven exploration, and learn from the first descents.
steps: A playable alpha and the token launch.
Player feedback shapes the next passage.
No direct token payouts during alpha.

phases.title: The next passage
phases.label: Beta & points
phases.summary: Bring the expedition into beta and introduce points for a future airdrop. Develop the experience around what players discover in the castle.
steps: A points system for a future airdrop.
Further details announced with this phase.

phases.title: Crystals with real value
phases.label: Full release & rewards
phases.summary: The full release targets direct $DCG rewards together with fractions of supported RWA tokens. NVDA, AAPL and MSFT are examples of intended token integrations for the crystal reward layer.
steps: Direct rewards begin with this phase.
Supported RWA assets confirmed before activation.
A complete release beyond the alpha and beta.

phases.title: Beyond the gates
phases.label: DEX & CEX
phases.summary: Pursue exchange listings and broader access to $DCG. DEX and CEX availability will be announced through official project channels as arrangements are confirmed.
steps: Announce confirmed venues rather than dates.

phases.title: The chain below
phases.label: The DiggerChain network
phases.summary: Research a DiggerChain L3 on Robinhood Chain, drawing on ideas from Pearl. Explore making the game a core part of the network's mining model: a chain built around the descent itself.
steps: Explore a dedicated network and its architecture.
Research game-based mining and security rules.
Turn the DiggerChain name into a network vision.
